reviews.text: Me and my two Jack Russells (Chip & Dale) absolutely love this place! Will definitely be back!

Place used to be great but Macie kept forgetting to schedule follow up appts  (2-3 times in a row) and I would have to remind her. And by follow ups I mean me or my mom would schedule next appt at the store once pups were groomed. And/or had last minute cancellation from her and staff wanted me to be with a different groomer. No thanks. My puppies get used to a certain groomer so I don’t want to do a random switch on them when they were comfortable with her.

I had a wonderful experience at The Paw Spa. The staff was warm, professional, and treated my pet with genuine care throughout the visit. The salon was clean and welcoming, and the grooming was done with great attention to detail. My pet looked fantastic, smelled fresh, and seemed relaxed afterward. The entire experience was smooth, and I would happily recommend The Paw Spa to anyone looking for quality pet grooming services.

I had a wonderful experience at The Paw Spa. The staff was friendly, professional, and made my pet feel comfortable throughout the grooming appointment. The salon was clean, well-maintained, and the grooming was done exactly as requested. My pet came back looking fantastic, smelling fresh, and seemed happy and relaxed. I'd definitely return and highly recommend The Paw Spa for quality grooming services.

I love getting my Penelope girl groomed at the Pet Spa. Every groomer is so talented. She always comes out looking like plush dog! Yesterday she got her grooming done by Axel and we absolutely loved it! They make sure to work quickly so that your baby doesn’t have to stay there all day. Plus, we are always welcomed with kindness! Highly recommend this place.

They did a great job! Usually I take my dog to Petco, because for whatever reason I assumed they would be the cheapest. This place is quite a bit closer to my apartment though, so I thought that I would give it a shot.

My dog is a medium sized (about 50 lbs) terrier mix with wiry, scruffy hair. For a bath & haircut, they charged $90. I got the additional package "downtown dog" which included teeth brushing and nail grinding, which was $15. I feel like this is about the same as what Petco would have charged me, so I was happy with the prices. I was worried it would be more, for a boutique spot.

The appointment took about two hours. Staff were friendly. The cut came out looking good, and I am happy overall. I will go here from now on.
Great groomers. Dogs are always happy to go there. Very friendly!
Ash is awesome and a amazing groomer!

This was the worst haircut we’ve had in three years. My toy poodle’s body wasn’t properly groomed, and his head was shaped square instead of the cute round shape they usually have. I spent an hour fixing it at home after paying $100+.

On top of that, our Saturday appointment was cancelled just one hour before, with no apology when we rebooked. The front desk staff seemed cold and unwelcoming. Very disappointed overall.
I’ve been coming here for a little over a year and they never disappoint! Mylo looks fabulous every time 🤗💗 thanks Alana!!
Highly recommend! They are so good with both our pups— and do a beautiful job.
Macie is the best! She always makes my dogs feel comfortable and happy. The Paw Spa team is top-notch, and I couldn’t recommend them more.

made an appointment with one specific groomer and when I picked her up they slipped up and told me the male groomer groomed her. he didn’t express her anal glands or pluck her ears like I requested and PAID FOR! they also didn’t cut her down AT ALL which caused her to maher matted shortly after the grooming; so I just had to get her shaved down this grooming. very disappointed . for $130 for a 4.5 pound dog is INSANEEEEEEEEE
Brought my dog here for a birthday grooming and it was such a pleasant experience! The staff was friendly, the salon spotless, and my pup looked adorable. We’ll definitely be back!

I been going to Macie for about a year now and I am in love with how she leaves my cavalier Milo I know he is well taken care of when I drop him off, I always recommend my friends who have pets to come here so they can get taken care of 💕

Zedd has been seeing Macie for 4 years now, since as soon as he had all his puppy vaccines! She used to work out of a spot in Plano but left to open her own spot - this one in Dallas! She was kind enough to recommend some groomers at the Plano spot that could take over for Zedd’s grooming & trust me I tried them…But nobody takes care of my boy like she does! We ended up following her to the Paw Spa and I happily make the drive from Frisco/Prosper every 8 ish weeks because she is so worth it!!
Inspo pics help btw if you’re wanting a specific look, I did that 1x when he was a puppy and have kept that look ever since! She by now even knows we usually go short for summer and longer for winter & knows exactly what we want & does a great job giving him that teddy bear fluff.

Her pricing is fair, her work is phenomenal & my dog is always happy and well taken care of!

Here’s his latest summer cut!

Macie and the Paw Spa team do an amazing job! We’ve taken our golden here for nearly a year, and he’s always come back looking and smelling great. He’s a very active, nosy dog, and we are so thankful for the team’s patience that makes the process so easy for us!
I love the way they groom my golden retriever!

I brought my dog here for a bath, nail trim, and deshedding. The staff was friendly and the service was impressively quick—everything was done in about an hour. While the bath and nail trim were fine, the deshedding wasn’t as thorough as I’d hoped, which may be due to the short turnaround time. Overall, I appreciate the convenience, but the quality didn’t quite match the price point for me.
Great staff, good pricing and the dogs love it.

Terrible experience and it’s taken over a month to write this review. My yorkie was cut badly behind the ear and around his body with his. They said he “did well” with no mention of his wounds. He acted strange for 3 weeks and I took him to the vet who confirmed there wasn’t anything wrong expect the trauma. I won’t be going back and wish I didn’t tip them 😭
Great price. Friendly staff.
The best experience I have ever had. The owner was so friendly and helpful. I can’t recommend this place enough. I will definitely be back!
Best pet spa I have ever been to!
I bring my girl Hazel here for her usual grooming and she always comes out looking great! They always do such a great job at providing the best service :) Definitely recommend!!!

Hello. We don't have any client in our system named Liella. Could you please contact us at info@pawspadallas.com so we could get more information. 
Thank you
Fantastic grooming services. I’ve brought my two dogs here and Macy does a great job. Highly highly recommend.
Not exactly what we discussed beforehand but still cute.

Absolutely obsessed with The Paw Spa! Macy the owner is AMAZING with my mini doodle and always has her looking like the diva she is! They really take care of my babies even my big boy Kaos! They have the BEST selection of clothes and have the most amazing dog crocs…treats all the above! You won’t be disappointed! 🙃 …

Recently relocated to Dallas. I cannot find a good groomer to save my life. Someone recommended this place; so I gave it a shot. I have not been this pissed in a long time. I gave the groomer specific instructions, like specific to the 10th power. I said round puppy dog face. I don’t know what she did. She also took the tail down too low. This person clearly doesn’t know how to groom (Sloppy work). The dog came home with bugga’s in his eyes. The owner should choose better groomers. Because she’s going to be constantly losing money with that one.
Absolutely wonderful place they were so patient with my puppy and made accommodations 1000 out of 10 !!!! Absolutely recommend This beautiful place!!
First time here and was wondering why I didn’t come here sooner! Our puppy looks and smells amazing. Thank you Paw Spa, we’ll be back soon! ❤️
Pricy but worth it ! Every time I take them they always come out looking so adorable & they always come out with small accessories
Beautiful work and wonderful customer service!
I take my dog here as a walk in to get her nails trimmed, the staff here is very sweet and quick and have a good selection of cheap good quality treats

I just took my furbaby here and the reviews from before did not disappoint. The inside of the shop is the cutest thing I ever seen! So many goodies and toys for your dogs. The vibes are fun and the staff member greeted me as soon as I walked in. Process was seamless for drop off and pick up with text notification. He was even ready before schedule! They were so thorough with removing his tear stains as well. I will be coming back and using them in the future!
The very best staff and exceptional quality services. Can’t wait to bring my dog back to see Macie!

I had been going to this pet spa since they opened in downtown, and they were truly amazing, always taking great care of my senior dog.

However, things have changed recently. I booked a grooming appointment through their app, but the system ended up scheduling it for the following week instead. My main issue was the way I was treated by the staff member when I arrived. She seemed irritated that I walked in, never explained what went wrong with the booking, didn’t offer any alternative date, and simply said, "You don’t have a reservation," with an annoyed attitude.

That night, the owner texted me to confirm I didn’t have a reservation but never addressed my complaint about the staff member’s behavior.

While the groomers do a good job, the service needs improvement. There are other great pet spas in Dallas to consider.
Loveddd this place

It was Milo’s first time going to The Paw Spa the staff is very nice and friendly. He truly looks so different very handsome, very adorable, very demure. I’m glad I found this place it’s amazing work I have been doing my research to find the best place to take my puppy. We will be coming back it was an 11/10 !!!

This was my first time using the paw spa. I have a 15 lb 10yr old Pomeranian.
Just a simple cut I'm not picky. But then they charged 10 more dollars for his coat being so compacted! I didn't understand that since he is groomed every 6 …

This is the best dog groomer I have found in Dallas . They are so caring and do an excellent job my friend and I both take our dogs there and the owner is so sweet. We love this place and they even have a super cute store for all your pet supplies.
Amazing staff! The owner super cool and just amazing!
The best place for my Roma at downtown ✨
